summary: Austin Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the availability of a NI 43-101 technical report on its Stockade Mountain Project. The report documents historical exploration, recent drilling results, and geophysical survey findings. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of technical information with no corporate transaction, board recommendation, or structural change. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, capital return, or any other special situation.
